concept.title: Opened files and copies
concept.shortdesc: On a phone or tablet, uFTi works on its own copy of the file you choose, so the file you chose stays as it was.

conbody.p: When you choose a family tree file, gets a copy of it and keeps the copy as its own. When the file opens, says so in one line. It works on that copy, so the file you chose does not change.

section.title: The file you chose
section.p: The file you chose stays as it was, however much you add. That also means it does not show your new work.

section.title: Get your tree out
section.p: The copy that works on is not a file you can pick up and send. To get your tree out, choose on the card for your tree. Then choose where to put the file.
The file you save is a saved copy. It stays as it was when you made it. Make a new one after you add a lot.

section.title: Sending your tree
section.p: Send a copy that you saved. says why.
